submitted.rationale: Five EQE measurements taken across the line (Sb 0.17, 0.49, 0.75, 0.86, 0.89). Index 15 (Sb 0.754) gave 0.0306%, about 6x higher than any other. The rest of the line is near the noise floor, which fits wide-gap Al/Sb oxides absorbing weakly at 2.7 eV. Indices 14 and 16 next to it were not measured because the budget ran out.
